verdict.rationale: E2B supports writing multiple files, running many sandboxes concurrently (up to 100), and scripting via SDK/CLI, which enables some bulk-style automation, but there's no documented batch API for operating across many items/sandboxes in a single call or bulk file/command operations. missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch API (e.g., bulk create/kill/exec across sandboxes), documented examples of iterating over many items programmatically, evidence of performance/rate guarantees for large-scale bulk operations.
